Maria: Quick heads-up — small hotfix PR for runtime memory leak. Cutoff for hotpatch rolling at 22:00 PT today, need 2x approvals before cutoff. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5234
Kevin: On it, taking a look now.
Olivia: I can do a security review, low surface area but will check KMS/HSM usage and logging.
Sachin: I saw a flaky perf test earlier on main that might be unrelated. I can run the microbench locally against this patch.
Jen: FYI release checklist: must have two approvals, canary config updated, and rollback tag ready. If we miss cutoff we'll hold until next window.
Maria: CI is green except the macos perf job (flake). Patch is a 6-line cleanup in kv_cache.cc.
Kevin: Commented on a nit in the PR, nothing blocking. :thumbsup:
Olivia: Security notes: no new network surface; logs unchanged. LGTM.
Sachin: Ran the benchmark, mem growth fixed on my run. No perf regression. LGTM from infra side.
Alex: Merge gate update: auto-merge blocked until 2 approvals; after 2x LGTM I'll kick the canary deploy and monitor 15m. Canary route: canary-1 -> 10% traffic.
deploy-bot: [ci/status] all required checks passed (except optional macos-perf). Mergeable: true (pending approvals).
Kevin: Approving in GitHub now.
Maria: We're at 21:48 PT — plan to merge at 21:55 if approvals are in. @Olivia @Sachin please ping if anything else.
Olivia: Confirmed, will watch canary metrics post-merge.
Sachin: I'll keep an eye on memory graphs and kv-hit rates for 30m.
Jen: If anything odd, rollback plan is tag v1.9.3-rollback + traffic shift to stable. I'll be on call for cutover.
Maria: Thanks everyone — if both LGTM land before 21:55 I will merge and kick canary. Otherwise we hold.
Kevin: LGTM — merging when Maria triggers.
Maria: Merged at 21:54 PT, deploy-bot will post updates. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for PR #5234. Route: canary-1 (10%). Monitoring for 15m. Alerts: on memory growth or error-rate >0.5%.
Alex: Noted — will escalate to SRE if alerts fire. Good job team.
